title: Enrollment with one click
hook: Two stated cases: explore the absolute change in a toy enrollment comparison.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the absolute change in a toy enrollment comparison affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Gap, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the absolute change in a toy enrollment comparison in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy comparison has 60/100 in A and 45/100 in B. What is A minus B in percentage points?
